storyTitle: Apply Statement Credit for Bill Reduction
oneSentenceStory: Customer checks current coin balance and cashback to allocate rewards directly to statement credit.
customerSituation: Customer visits mobile app to review rewards standing and current goal progress.
storyTension: Ensuring transparent coin-to-conversion rates without encountering irrelevant vouchers or gamification.
customerResolution: Direct, frictionless application of accumulated rewards as a statement credit on the linked card.
primaryOutcome: Effortless tracking and application of statement credits for bill reduction.
